signin.heading: Sign in to OpsTrack
signin.subtitle: Accounts are created by the admin. Enter your work email and we'll send you a 6-digit code.
signin.codeResent: A new code is on its way.
signin.errEmailInvalid: That doesn't look like an email address.
signin.errNoAccount: No account with that email — accounts are created by the admin. Check the address or ask for an invite.
signin.errCodeInvalid: That code is wrong or has expired. Request a new one.
signin.errRateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
signin.errNetwork: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
signin.errGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
signin.notConfigured: This build has no backend configured, so sign-in is unavailable.

settings.title: Settings
settings.membersHint: Accounts are created and removed by an admin.
settings.membersSoon: Adding and removing teammates arrives in a later sitting, once entries are in place.
settings.membersAdminOnly: Only admins can manage team members.

admin.title: Administration
admin.errForbidden: You don't have permission to change this. Only an admin can.

tracks.title: Tracks
tracks.subtitle: Add, rename, recolour and reorder the tracks that work is filed under.
tracks.name: Name (English)
tracks.colorHint: Two hexes, so the identity bar keeps its contrast in both themes.
tracks.deleteBody: “{name}” will be removed permanently. This can't be undone.
tracks.deleteBodyInUse: “{name}” still holds {entries} entries, {meetings} meetings and {templates} templates. Choose where to move them first.
tracks.archiveBody: “{name}” disappears from the pickers. Existing items keep it and nothing is deleted.
tracks.discardBody: Your edits to this track haven't been saved. Leaving now discards them.
tracks.reassignNoTargets: There is no other active track to move them to. Add one, or restore an archived track, then delete this one.
tracks.emptyHint: Add your first track to start filing work under it.
tracks.errNameLong: Keep the name to {max} characters or fewer.
tracks.errNameTaken: Another track already uses that name.
tracks.errNameArTaken: Another track already uses that Arabic name.
tracks.errInUse: That track still holds items. Move them to another track first.
tracks.errLastTrack: At least one active track has to remain.
tracks.errReassignArchived: That destination is archived. Items moved there would disappear from every list — pick an active track.
tracks.errReassignSelf: Pick a different track to move the items to.
tracks.errNotFound: That track no longer exists. Reload the list.

placeholder.followups: Your overdue, due, stale, blocked and unassigned items will gather here in phase 4.

placeholder.trackDetail: This track's chronological log arrives in phase 5.
placeholder.entry: The entry detail panel and its update thread arrive in phase 2.
placeholder.dashboard: Charts and the weekly digest arrive in phase 8.
